question_or_proposition: For Outfall 001 (intermittent flow), does footnote *1 ('When discharging.') make the (*1)-marked monitoring frequencies—and any associated effluent limit compliance evaluations for parameters measured under those requirements—applicable only during periods when discharge is actually occurring, rather than during periods when Outfall 001 is not discharging?
required_context: Outfall 001 intermittent-flow authorization and (*1)-marked monitoring requirements in Section A (pH, flow, TSS, total residual chlorine, cyanide, total dissolved solids)
Evidence of discharge occurrence or absence for evaluated monitoring periods (e.g., flow reports or documented no-discharge periods)
notes: Footnote *1 annotates monitoring frequencies for an intermittent outfall; its interpretation determines whether monitoring was required (Purpose B), whether missing results reflect conditional non-requirement versus inadequate evidence (Purpose C), and whether numeric limits apply for periods with reported measurements (Purpose A).
